joinRule: Owned landmark protected rectangles take precedence over nominal core borders and minimum-error seams. Unresolved conflicts require local authoring review.
coverageRule: Every city point belongs to an active core; outside-city cores are optional context. Halos retain neighboring context, including outside the master rectangle.
